body:
## 检查更新

- 「检查更新」现在优先读取官网的版本清单。即使 GitHub 的共享接口暂时限流，也能查看最新正式版、更新说明和下载入口。
- 官网清单暂不可用时，Renamint 会尝试官方 Releases API。两个来源都不可用时，可以从「设置 → 版本信息」直接打开官方发布页。
- 「上次成功检查」显示最近一次取得版本信息的时间。

旧版若提示「检查过于频繁」，可从官网下载此 DMG，退出 Renamint 后将新版拖入「应用程序」。适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，最低系统为 macOS 26。

## Checking for updates

- Renamint now checks the same release list as the website. You can see the latest version, release notes, and installer even when the shared GitHub API quota is exhausted.
- If the list is unavailable, Renamint tries the official Releases API. If both sources are unavailable, you can open the release page directly from Settings.
- “Last successful check” shows when Renamint last retrieved release information.

If an older version says “Too many requests,” download this DMG from the website, quit Renamint, and drag the new app into Applications. Requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 26 or later.
